title: Kascade: A Practical Sparse Attention Method for Long-Context LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2512.16391v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Attention is the dominant source of latency during long-context LLM inference, an increasingly popular workload with reasoning models and RAG. We propose Kascade, a training-free sparse attention method that leverages known observations such as 1) post-softmax attention is intrinsically sparse, and 2) the identity of high-weight keys is stable across nearby layers. Kascade computes exact Top-k indices in a small set of anchor layers, then reuses those indices in intermediate reuse layers. The anchor layers are selected algorithmically, via a dynamic-programming objective that maximizes cross-layer similarity over a development set, allowing easy deployment across models. The method incorporates efficient implementation constraints (e.g. tile-level operations), across both prefill and decode attention. The Top-k selection and reuse in Kascade is head-aware and we show in our experiments that this is critical for high accuracy. K

translated_title: Kascade：一种用于长上下文大语言模型推理的实用稀疏注意力方法
translated_abstract: 注意力是长上下文大语言模型推理过程中延迟的主要来源，而这类工作负载在推理模型和RAG（检索增强生成）场景中日益流行。我们提出了Kascade，一种无需训练的稀疏注意力方法，它利用了以下已知观察结果：1）softmax之后的注意力本质上是稀疏的；2）高权重键的身份在相邻层之间是稳定的。Kascade在少量锚点层中计算精确的Top-k索引，然后在中间的复用层中重用这些索引。锚点层通过算法选择，采用动态规划目标在开发集上最大化跨层相似度，从而能够轻松部署到不同模型上。该方法在预填充和解码两个阶段的注意力中都纳入了高效的实现约束（例如瓦片级操作）。Kascade中的Top-k选择和复用是感知注意力头的，并且我们在实验中证明这对于实现高精度至关重要。
tldr: Kascade是一种无需训练的稀疏注意力方法，通过在算法选择的少量锚点层中计算精确Top-k索引并在相邻层复用，在保持高精度的同时显著加速长上下文大语言模型推理。
en_tdlr: Kascade is a training-free sparse attention method that accelerates long-context LLM inference by computing exact Top-k indices in algorithmically-selected anchor layers and reusing them across nearby layers, achieving high accuracy through head-aware selection.
